findings.why: A number field with max (3) below min (5) used to be rejected with 400 and is now accepted, so validation got weaker; no claim covers this, since c1 only concerns max 0.

Patching a number field to max 0.5 with min 1 is now accepted instead of rejected with 400, which leaves an unsatisfiable range stored (as get_coll and the record error message show); no claim predicts this weakened validation.
